entries.name: Hoarded Kernel
entries.flavor: Every dwindling ember spares one grain for later. This one remembers why.

entries.name: Gilded Husk
entries.flavor: Painted over what it used to be, and prouder for it.

entries.name: Lacquerclip
entries.flavor: A single clasp, lacquered past its worth and carried anyway.

entries.name: Scavenged Purse
entries.flavor: Whatever the quartermaster didn't want, the pouch took gladly.

entries.name: Bead of Ash
entries.flavor: What the last fire couldn't finish burning, it left behind as currency.

entries.name: Rustloop
entries.flavor: Rings rust; the habit of keeping one does not.

entries.name: Burgeoning Silo
entries.flavor: Full past its seams, and still someone keeps filling it.

entries.name: Holding Coffer
entries.flavor: The roots hold the wall. The coffer holds everything else.

entries.name: Token of the Ledger
entries.flavor: A single page, copied so many times no one remembers the first hand.

entries.name: Locket of Appraisal
entries.flavor: Opened once by an expert, and never quite closed the same way since.

entries.name: Earthpod
entries.flavor: Buried on purpose, dug up on schedule.

entries.name: Pouch of Requisition
entries.flavor: Signed, stamped, and somehow still empty when it arrives.

entries.name: Wandering Trinket
entries.flavor: It rode one spore farther than the garden that grew it.

entries.name: Tended Bloom
entries.flavor: Someone waters it who has no further use for water.

entries.name: Root of the Foundation
entries.flavor: Every wall the garden ever built started as one stubborn root.

entries.name: Seed of the Glut
entries.flavor: Plant enough and eventually the ground stops asking for more.

entries.name: Patched Satchel
entries.flavor: Held together by whoever needed it to hold one more thing.

entries.name: Twinbead
entries.flavor: Grown as one, carried as two, spent as either.

entries.name: Signet of the Coalbed
entries.flavor: Every coin it grants is a coal it stops banking for winter.

entries.name: Signet of Annexation
entries.flavor: Claim the neighbor's yield, and the strength to defend your own thins to pay for it.

entries.name: Twin Sun-Gleaner
entries.flavor: A heavy, golden vessel shaped like a blooming sunflower, forged from solidified sunlight and packed with endless, shimmering seeds.

entries.name: Gilded Bloom
entries.flavor: A heavy, petal-shaped coin of solid silver, inlaid with a single, brilliant diamond at its center.

entries.name: Spore Accumulator
entries.flavor: A dense, translucent sphere of amber-colored mycelium that pulses with stored sunlight, swelling in size as it absorbs ambient energy.

entries.name: Prismatic Unboxing
entries.flavor: A multifaceted diamond container that holds a hidden treasure within its brilliant, shifting facets.

entries.name: Crimson Seedling
entries.flavor: A heavy, calcified lotus bulb that leaks thick, nutrient-rich ichor, turning every fallen foe into a blooming patch of red.

entries.name: Gluttonous Spore-Husk
entries.flavor: A pulsating, necrotized fungal mass that pulses with a sickly golden light, offering immense vitality at the cost of stability.

entries.name: Industrial License
entries.flavor: A heavy, notched pickaxe head forged from Netherite, stamped with a glowing permit of ownership.

entries.name: Gilded Sprout
entries.flavor: A ceramic vessel overflowing with unnaturally vibrant, oversized petals that seem to pulse with the rhythm of a grand announcement.

entries.name: Golden Kernel Coin
entries.flavor: A heavy, butter-slicked corn kernel encased in a thin layer of gold, shaped like a minted coin.

entries.name: Solar Sprout
entries.flavor: A rapid-blooming sunflower core encased in a polished golden frame that pulses with warmth.

entries.name: Gilded Chronometer
entries.flavor: A heavy, ticking sphere of solid gold, suspended by silver wires that pulse with the rhythm of a heartbeat.

entries.name: Edgar's Reliquary
entries.flavor: A silver-cast parcel containing the preserved remains of a high-value corpse, wrapped in heavy metal chains.

entries.name: Frost-Bound Seasonal Bundle
entries.flavor: A crystalline gift box containing frozen botanical specimens, offered at a steep discount to those who can withstand the chill.

entries.name: Sun-Drenched Spore-Pod
entries.flavor: A translucent, glowing bulb that pulses with warmth, containing concentrated solar essence and fertile soil.

entries.name: Gilded Bloom Harvest
entries.flavor: A heavy, petal-shaped medallion cast from solid gold, perpetually shedding fine, shimmering pollen that smells of minted coins.

entries.name: Vascular Siphon
entries.flavor: A network of translucent, pulsing veins encased in a calcified, rot-blackened husk, constantly twitching as if searching for a pulse to drain.

entries.name: Frozen Swan's Ransom
entries.flavor: A delicate, ice-carved swan figurine that, when held, commands the relentless march of the undead.

entries.name: Jade-Spike Vortex
entries.flavor: A jagged shard of emerald jade, carved into the likeness of a spiked desert dweller, drifts weightlessly through the ether. Its core is a concentrated vortex of swirling jade dust and pressurized wind, contained within a translucent, needle-streaked crystalline shell.

entries.name: Spined Canopy Aegis
entries.flavor: A dense, interlocking lattice of hardened cactus needles and thick, waxy membranes that forms a protective dome over the unit.

entries.name: Bursting Cherry Spore
entries.flavor: A pressurized, crimson-stained fungal bulb that releases thick, fragrant clouds of explosive pollen upon impact.

entries.name: Sprout-Burst Tuber
entries.flavor: A heavy, starch-filled bulb encased in a pressurized cherry-blossom shell, ready to burst upon rapid maturation.

entries.name: The Silent Ledger of Lead
entries.flavor: A heavy, ink-stained newsprint wrapped around a leaden cylinder, vibrating with the rhythmic thud of a printing press.

entries.name: Petal-Shot Siphon
entries.flavor: A polished wooden vessel shaped like a blooming cherry branch, containing concentrated nectar that accelerates the flow of resources.

entries.name: Burst-Ripened Spore-Pod
entries.flavor: A semi-ripe cherry-colored fungal bulb, suspended by thick, sticky filaments, ready to detonate upon impact.

entries.name: Crimson Gourd Core
entries.flavor: A dense, explosive sphere of pulpy cherry-flesh encased in a thick, protective pumpkin rind.

entries.name: Gushing Pulp-Cyst
entries.flavor: A swollen, weeping sac of fermented crimson, pulsing with the rhythmic tremor of a hungry, necrotic heart.

entries.name: Ruptured Nectar Husk
entries.flavor: A jagged, crimson-stained shell of fermented pulp and splintered pits, pulsing with a restless, necrotic pressure.

entries.name: Vessel of the Unspent Pulse
entries.flavor: A jagged, hollowed engine block of calcified cherry-wood and rusted iron, still twitching with the kinetic energy of a dying star.

entries.name: Cherry-Torch Stump-Core
entries.flavor: A glowing, resinous knot of cherry-wood and eternal flame, pulsing with the rhythm of a growing forest.

entries.name: Gulping Bloom Vessel
entries.flavor: A translucent, bulbous container shaped like a wide, toothy maw, filled with a viscous, bubbling digestive fluid that provides sustenance to those nearby.

entries.name: Autumnal Essence Graft
entries.flavor: A pressed, bruised petal encased in amber-like resin, pulsing with the concentrated vitality of a dying field.

entries.name: Kernel-Burst Siphon
entries.flavor: A heavy, pressurized canister made of hardened corn husks and brass, designed to launch golden kernels with explosive force.

entries.name: Unfinished Eraser-Stub
entries.flavor: A blunt, rubbery cylinder that refuses to acknowledge its own failure.

entries.name: Golden Kernel Suspension
entries.flavor: A cluster of floating, butter-slicked kernels that drift through the air to provide sustenance.

entries.name: Golden Kernel Pouch
entries.flavor: A heavy, grease-slicked pouch filled with bouncing kernels that spill out with rhythmic force.

entries.name: Brass-Casing Volley
entries.flavor: A collection of spent, polished brass casings that rattle with the rhythm of a firing pin.

entries.name: Spore-Sown Relinquishment
entries.flavor: A heavy, fungal-encrusted base of decayed corn-stalks and zombie-flesh, designed to launch spores in exchange for stability.

entries.name: 伞叶覆膜
entries.flavor: 由僵尸组织而成的伞叶，覆有厚重的腐肉层，能将冲击击退并定格在原地。

entries.name: Spore-Clotted Tuber-Core
entries.flavor: A dense, pulsating mass of fermented starch and necrotic matter, held together by the sheer force of concentrated decay.

entries.name: Fractured Yield-Shard
entries.flavor: A jagged, unstable cluster of mimic-diamonds that pulses with the rhythm of a sudden windfall, though its very presence invites a catastrophic collapse.

entries.name: Carapace of the Prismatic Tuber
entries.flavor: A dense, faceted kernel of earth-grown diamond, hard as a mountain and rich as a treasury.

entries.name: Luminous Nested Core
entries.flavor: A geometric prism of light, shaped like a world within a world, crafted from the essence of a zombie's radiant spirit.

entries.name: Dolphin-Whale Gyro-Shell
entries.flavor: A polished, white-pearl shell shaped like a leaping dolphin, spinning rapidly to release a rhythmic pulse of wealth.

entries.name: Aquarium Keeper's Part-Time Ledger
entries.flavor: A heavy, water-logged ledger bound in preserved skin, containing the unpaid wages of those who serve the deep.

entries.name: Cinder-Leaf Reliquary
entries.flavor: A scorched, three-lobed vessel of calcified ash and drifting down, releasing a cloud of choking soot upon every strike.

entries.name: Spore-Lineage Manual-Burst
entries.flavor: A heavy, hand-cranked piston made of calcified fungal matter that forces a continuous, devastating stream of spores across the entire battlefield.

entries.name: Carcass-Burst Bulb
entries.flavor: A swollen, pungent bulb of fermented remains that ruptures with a violent, stinking pop upon impact.

entries.name: Spore-Casing Volley-Core
entries.flavor: A heavy, four-chambered fungal canister, pulsating with the pressure of a thousand spent shells.

entries.name: Searing Seed-Core
entries.flavor: A dormant, swollen bulb of concentrated spice that pulses with internal heat, waiting for the moment of total combustion.

entries.name: Vines of Ruin
entries.flavor: A mass of dark, suffocating aquatic flora that constricts and drains the life from everything it touches.

entries.name: Isotope-Core Husk
entries.flavor: A dense, lead-lined shell containing a pulsating, radioactive kernel that absorbs kinetic impact to fuel its internal reaction.

entries.name: Reactor-Gourd Core
entries.flavor: A pulsating, heavy vessel of organic matter and volatile energy, shaped like a hollowed pumpkin and filled with a glowing, pressurized sludge.

entries.name: Spore-Burst Spore-Core
entries.flavor: A pulsating, bulbous fungal mass that rhythmically expands and contracts, releasing microscopic, explosive spores that sense the vibrations of the dying.

entries.name: 陨星坠落之核
entries.flavor: 化作流星坠向地面，在毁灭的撞击中砸出财富的裂痕。

entries.name: Spore-Pod Spigot
entries.flavor: A cluster of tiny, pressurized green spheres that pulse with kinetic energy, ready to burst.

entries.name: Obsidian Kinetic-Core
entries.flavor: A pair of twin-barreled conduits of polished obsidian and tempered brass, pulsing with a rhythmic, mechanical thrum of pressurized shadow.

entries.name: River-Flowing Iron-Husk
entries.flavor: A heavy, continuous stream of reinforced plating that surges forward like a flood of iron.

entries.name: Grand Dreadnought Gear
entries.flavor: A massive, rotating cogwheel forged from rusted battleship plating and pulsating with necrotic energy, driving the relentless advance of the undead legion.

entries.name: Trident-Breach Spire
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted iron ram, shaped like a jagged three-pronged spear, designed to tip the balance of any formation.

entries.name: Trident-Spike Piston
entries.flavor: A heavy, three-pronged iron rammer that channels the momentum of a driver's charge into a singular, crushing impact.

entries.name: Trident-Driver's Surplus
entries.flavor: A heavy, multi-pronged relic forged from the reinforced plating of a snow-beast's harness, used by elite drivers to stabilize their charge.

entries.name: Trident Verdict of the Unfilled
entries.flavor: A heavy, three-pronged iron gavel that pours out endless supplies of munitions to satisfy the court's hunger.

entries.name: Conductive Bulb-Core
entries.flavor: A pulsating, translucent onion bulb filled with crackling blue currents that draws energy from the fallen to fuel the next strike.

entries.name: Colossus Specimen Ledger
entries.flavor: A heavy, leather-bound tome encased in a massive, ivory-carved elephantine frame, used by researchers to catalog the movements of gargantuan entities.

entries.name: The Dean's Indignant Ledger
entries.flavor: A heavy, leather-bound tome bound in desiccated skin, perpetually trembling with the fury of a scholar denied his quietude.

entries.name: Crimson Petal Volley-Core
entries.flavor: A swirling, condensed sphere of molten nectar and hardened pollen, pulsing with the rhythm of a thousand blooming strikes.

entries.name: Void-Lattice Repository
entries.flavor: A shifting arrangement of obsidian-rimmed cards that fold into a hollowed, glowing pumpkin-shaped vessel, allowing any actor to draw from a shared well of essence.

entries.name: Silt-Void Vessel
entries.flavor: A heavy, shifting mass of unformed loam that absorbs the weight of the world to fuel its own expansion.

entries.name: Silt-Weight Reliquary
entries.flavor: A heavy, unformed mass of primordial loam that pulses with the crushing weight of the deep earth.

entries.name: Lavender Haze Reliquary
entries.flavor: A translucent, shimmering silhouette of a decayed wanderer, trailing ethereal ribbons of lavender smoke that pulse like a slow, rhythmic heartbeat.

entries.name: Vault-Breaker's Grudge
entries.flavor: A heavy, jagged slab of petrified marrow and iron-veined stone, pulsing with the violent urge to leap through any barrier.

entries.name: Silt-Pulse Core
entries.flavor: A heavy, rhythmic vibration of unformed loam that anchors the soul to the planet's foundation.

entries.name: Spore-Casing Ignition
entries.flavor: A heavy, bulbous seed pod encased in scorched bark, designed to burst upon impact.

entries.name: Thunder-Bound Silk-Fuse
entries.flavor: A tightly wound bundle of crimson silk and sulfurous cord, crackling with the restless energy of a storm held in check.

entries.name: Crimson Vapor Spore
entries.flavor: A pressurized, glowing fungal bulb that constantly emits a thick, heated haze.

entries.name: Luminous Tuber Spark
entries.flavor: A jagged, starch-filled core encased in a translucent, crackling shell that reflects the violent energy within.

entries.name: Cinder-Spatter Lens
entries.flavor: A molten, cracked glass monocle that radiates intense heat, causing every shot to splinter into a spray of burning embers.

entries.name: Gourd-Core Singularity
entries.flavor: A dense, glowing mass of concentrated vegetable matter and solar heat, where individual sparks merge into a singular, heavy essence.

entries.name: Vaporous Soul-Vessel
entries.flavor: A swirling, translucent orb containing the restless echoes of the fallen, drifting with an indifferent grace.

entries.name: Glacial Pulse Core
entries.flavor: A frozen, translucent sphere that emits rhythmic frost-shattered shockwaves.

entries.name: Colossus's Unyielding Toll
entries.flavor: A massive, slab-like fragment of calcified bone and graveyard soil, heavy enough to crush the very ground it rests upon, indifferent to the carnage it leaves in its wake.

entries.name: Trifoliate Grave-Sprout
entries.flavor: A cluster of three decaying leaves, pulsing with the rhythm of a restless tomb.

entries.name: Pungent Spore-Cloud Reliquary
entries.flavor: A hollowed, bulbous fungal vessel that continuously emits a thick, garlic-scented vapor, obscuring the air with pungent spores.

entries.name: Pungent Kernel-Shell
entries.flavor: A dense, layered nut encased in a sharp, aromatic skin that provides a sudden burst of flavor upon the first bite.

entries.name: Pod-Burst Spore-Casing
entries.flavor: A cluster of dried, garlic-scented seed pods that rhythmically snap open, releasing pressurized pea-like projectiles.

entries.name: Allium Canopy
entries.flavor: A rigid, fibrous parasol woven from dried garlic skins and necrotic fibers, designed to push back the encroaching dead.

entries.name: Legume-Sprout Magazine
entries.flavor: A polished brass cylinder filled with swelling, green-tinted pellets that pulse with kinetic potential.

entries.name: Spore-Mist Sieve
entries.flavor: A porous, calcified fungal cap that continuously exhales a thick, obscuring haze to mask the growth of its kin.

entries.name: Cabbage-Core Spore-Pod
entries.flavor: A specialized, pressurized vessel crafted from tightly wound, necrotic cabbage leaves and zombie sinew, designed to launch organic projectiles with sudden force.

entries.name: Gilded Clove-Bite
entries.flavor: A heavy, golden bulb of garlic, etched with jagged lines like a row of teeth, smelling of ancient rot and wealth.

entries.name: Golden Card-Press Canister
entries.flavor: A heavy, rectangular vessel of gilded metal, filled with compressed layers of shimmering cards that can be recycled into raw essence.

entries.name: Gilded Husk-Sling
entries.flavor: A heavy, metallic umbrella handle carved from fossilized bone, used to hurl small, restless spirits at the enemy.

entries.name: Obsidian Projection Husk
entries.flavor: A high-density, holographic shell of volcanic glass that flickers with light.

entries.name: Cyclone's Rotting Spore
entries.flavor: A swirling, unstable mass of decaying clover leaves that pulls enemies into its vortex.

entries.name: Bulbous Allure
entries.flavor: A translucent, violet-capped bulb that pulses with a rhythmic, intoxicating scent.

entries.name: Amethyst Betrayal
entries.flavor: A swirling vortex of violet smoke and jagged obsidian shards that strikes with the sudden, betraying sting of a broken promise.

entries.name: Glacial Spore-Bolt
entries.flavor: A frozen, crystalline seed pod that pulses with a rhythmic, frost-laden tremor, ready to shatter into a thousand piercing shards.

entries.name: Glacial Spore-Caster
entries.flavor: A heavy, bulbous fungal pod encased in frost, designed to launch frozen spores with immense force.

entries.name: Glacial Petal Reliquary
entries.flavor: A frozen, translucent bloom that pulses with a rhythmic, restorative chill.

entries.name: Sinc-Linkage Core
entries.flavor: A complex assembly of interlocking brass gears and copper wiring, pulsing with the rhythmic efficiency of a masterwork machine.

entries.name: Iron-Shell Spore-Pod
entries.flavor: A dense, olive-shaped canister forged from hardened fungal matter, designed to rupture and release pressurized spores.

entries.name: Stitched Scavenger's Knot
entries.flavor: A crude, fraying knot of coarse twine and mismatched fabric scraps, smelling faintly of damp earth and old stuffing.

entries.name: Star-Burst Starfruit
entries.flavor: A plush, star-shaped fruit made of colorful felt and glitter, which bursts into a shower of confetti upon impact.

entries.name: Gilded Spotlight Baton
entries.flavor: A polished rod of solid gold that emits a blinding, rhythmic flash whenever the conductor strikes a beat.

entries.name: Dual-Handed Seed-Spitter
entries.flavor: A pair of polished, twin-barreled wooden canisters, shaped like rounded peas, designed to launch rapid-fire bursts.

entries.name: Spiteful Gourd Core
entries.flavor: A volatile, pressurized seed casing that launches itself with impatient fury, reclaiming its original position through explosive momentum.

entries.name: Silt-Bound Reliquary
entries.flavor: A preserved mass of water-logged peat and decayed vegetation, shaped into a heavy, unmoving knot that anchors the spirit to the earth.

entries.name: Mimic-Silt Core
entries.flavor: A pulsating, bio-synthetic mass of sediment and organic tissue that shifts its density to mimic the surrounding terrain.

entries.name: Luminous Vessel of Sustenance
entries.flavor: A heavy, ceramic pot that radiates a soft, constant glow, acting as a vessel for life-giving light.

entries.name: Echoing Alpha-Vibration
entries.flavor: A polished obsidian cylinder that hums with a low-frequency resonance, capturing the final vibrations of a target before they fade into silence.

entries.name: Sprout-Wall Bastion
entries.flavor: A dense formation of hardened winter shoots, interlocking like a living barricade to secure the perimeter.

entries.name: Glacial Bean-Shot Siphon
entries.flavor: A crystalline vessel containing frozen legumes that refracts kinetic energy into wealth.

entries.name: Ferro-Spore Diffuser
entries.flavor: A dense, magnetic fungal mass that constantly emits a thick, metallic smog, pulling nearby debris into its core.

entries.name: Ferro-Star Core
entries.flavor: A dense, star-shaped mass of magnetized starfruit pulp that pulls nearby resources toward the commander's center.

entries.name: Whirling Dust-Tumble
entries.flavor: A swirling mass of fine sand and dry grass that dances unpredictably, making it difficult for any eyes to track its true path.

entries.name: Nut-Shell Canopy
entries.flavor: A protective dome crafted from hardened, overlapping nut-shells and reinforced with thick, waxy leaves.

entries.name: Obsidian Grain Cycle
entries.flavor: A rhythmic transformation of dark stalks that bloom into wealth.

entries.name: Sprout-Burst Spud
entries.flavor: A heavy, earthen tuber that erupts from the soil to launch explosive pea-shrapnel.

entries.name: Pyramid of the Unreachable
entries.flavor: A geometric monolith of shifting sand and void-glass, pulsing with the rhythm of a gateway that leads only to what was lost.

entries.name: Chronos-Turbulence Sphere
entries.flavor: A swirling, translucent orb of displaced air and fractured time, pulsing with the rhythm of a dying dimension.

entries.name: Chronos-Seed Reliquary
entries.flavor: A shifting, translucent vessel containing a single, hyper-accelerated seed that exists in multiple moments at once.

entries.name: Squash-Crush Pavement
entries.flavor: A common, easily stepped-on mass of vegetable matter that feels quite ordinary.

entries.name: Chronos-Sprout Relic
entries.flavor: A shimmering, translucent seed that seems to exist in two places at once, appearing to drill through the fabric of time to find its old friend.

entries.name: Edgar's Strict Baton
entries.flavor: A rigid, polished conductor's baton crafted from heavy, dark ebony, used to enforce the rhythm of the dance academy's most disciplined movements.

entries.name: Spore-Cloud Diffuser
entries.flavor: A pressurized, bulbous vessel of thick, greyish fungal matter that emits a constant, low-pressure mist of fine spores.

entries.name: Ferro-Digestive Magnetite
entries.flavor: A heavy, pulsating mass of wet iron filings and digestive enzymes, held together by a constant, rhythmic magnetic pull.

entries.name: Vortex of the Verdigris Husk
entries.flavor: A spinning, serrated disc of petrified leaf-matter, pulsing with the restless energy of a restless grave.

entries.name: Argentum Bulbous
entries.flavor: A heavy, silver-plated clove that refuses to bruise, even under the heaviest bite.

entries.name: Spore-Sower's Cap
entries.flavor: A tiny, bulbous fungal cap that continuously releases a fine mist of concentrated spores.

entries.name: Glacial Core Reliquary
entries.flavor: A frozen, translucent sphere containing the inner essence of a thousand zombies, ensuring that even the smallest fragment contributes to the whole.

entries.name: Glacial Quad-Spike
entries.flavor: A small, frosted cylinder of compressed ice, shaped like a miniature magazine, containing four jagged icicle shards.

entries.name: Spore-Heap Proliferation
entries.flavor: A dense, pulsating mound of fungal matter that continuously sheds spores to saturate the battlefield.

entries.name: 旋鋼杉之遺
entries.flavor: A jagged splinter of steel-bark, still vibrating from the force of a thousand piercing shots.

entries.name: Scholar's Husk-Shell
entries.flavor: A hard, hollowed-out gourd shell filled with dense, nutrient-rich nut-meat and ancient ink.

entries.name: Comet-Shard Vector
entries.flavor: A jagged, five-pointed shard of celestial brass, forged from the core of a dying comet, pulses with a rhythmic, directional hum.

entries.name: 坠落星轨引力器
entries.flavor: 由坠落星辰的残骸锻造而成，其核心不断引动着天际的流星轨迹，使每一次合击都如同星辰坠落般精准且沉重。

entries.name: Edgar's Desperate Salvage
entries.flavor: A jagged, unpolished shard of scrap metal and discarded circuitry, salvaged with total disregard for safety or structural integrity.

entries.name: Cherried Sun-Burst Core
entries.flavor: A translucent, cherry-shaped orb containing a swirling, explosive solar core that pulses with the rhythm of a restless grave.

entries.name: Solar-Spore Quad-Cylinder
entries.flavor: A translucent, four-chambered glass canister containing concentrated sunlight and fungal spores, designed to discharge in rapid bursts.

entries.name: Solaris-Gourd-Vessel
entries.flavor: A translucent, amber-hued pumpkin shell that captures sunlight to fuel production.

entries.name: 未熟樱桃连射匣
entries.flavor: 由半熟的樱桃果肉与黄铜枪管熔铸而成，每一次震动都散发着甜腻的火药味。

entries.name: 豌豆弹幕匣
entries.flavor: 由无数颗微小的豌豆弹丸组成的金属圆筒，在震动中不断喷射出密集的弹幕。

entries.name: Jester's Rallying Totem
entries.flavor: A carved, grinning skull mounted on a wooden pole, used to broadcast a terrifying cheer that bolsters the undead ranks.

entries.name: 籽实连射器
entries.flavor: 由无数分裂的果实核心组成，在投掷时会因概率波动而产生连射的震荡。

entries.name: Apex Leap-Talon
entries.flavor: A heavy, spring-loaded claw forged from compressed permafrost and beast-king sinew, designed to anchor the decisive strike.

entries.name: Triple-Line Pea-Spitter
entries.flavor: A heavy, brass-barreled mechanism that cycles through three distinct grooves, ejecting dense, green-tinted pellets in rapid, rhythmic bursts.

entries.name: Sprout-Spike Scepter
entries.flavor: A wooden staff carved from a peach branch, bristling with sharpened jade needles that pulse with directional energy.

entries.name: Triline Silt-Bolt
entries.flavor: A cluster of three rigid, emerald-veined stalks that pulse with kinetic energy, ready to discharge concentrated organic slugs.

entries.name: Terracotta Sentry-Base
entries.flavor: A heavy, reinforced clay pedestal that stabilizes the shooter's stance and amplifies the impact of every shot.

entries.name: Stump-Wick Ember
entries.flavor: A hollowed pumpkin rind fused to a charred tree stump, containing a flickering, eternal flame.

entries.name: Meteorite Impact Core
entries.flavor: A heavy, jagged fragment of a fallen star that smashes into the ground with devastating force.

entries.name: Solaris Seed-Core
entries.flavor: A translucent, amber-hued sphere containing a concentrated spark of midday light, pulsing with the rhythm of a growing stem.

entries.name: Tri-Line Tuber Sprout
entries.flavor: A trio of earthen ridges that erupt from the soil to launch heavy starch-shells.

entries.name: Obsidian Volley-Core
entries.flavor: A dense, dark mass of obsidian-like plating that pulses with cold, violet flames, designed to facilitate a relentless barrage of fire.

entries.name: Glacial Spire Array
entries.flavor: A massive, jagged cluster of frozen needles that erupts from the ground, raining down a relentless storm of ice to overwhelm the battlefield.

entries.name: Sanguine Breach-Relic
entries.flavor: A jagged, obsidian-like shard forged from the calcified remains of a fallen legion, pulsing with the desperate heat of a final stand.

entries.name: Subspecies Synchrony-Core
entries.flavor: A cluster of hyper-dense, floating cherry pits encased in a translucent, pressurized resin, vibrating in perfect unison to stabilize the trajectory of every shot fired.

entries.name: Iron-Sovereign Monolith
entries.flavor: A heavy, unyielding slab of blackened tungsten, forged to stand alone against the tide.

entries.name: Lumen-Flux Singularity
entries.flavor: A spinning prism of condensed radiance that captures stray light and converts it into pure kinetic momentum.

entries.name: Allium-Burst Spore
entries.flavor: A cluster of pungent, split garlic cloves that scatter upon impact, releasing a cloud of flavorful essence.

entries.name: Luminous Soil-Burrower
entries.flavor: A pulsating, glowing gourd fragment that pulses with the rhythm of the earth, pulling essence from the recently departed.

entries.name: 尖刺子弹塑成物
